headline: Israeli Forces Clear Hezbollah Underground Network as Netanyahu Signals Iran Regime Overthrow Imminent
subheadline: IDF discovered command centers, weapons rooms, and living quarters built over two decades with Iranian funding on Mount Ali Taha ridge.
lede: Israeli forces completed clearing Hezbollah's underground infrastructure on Mount Ali Taha ridge in southern Lebanon's security zone, uncovering command centers, weapons rooms, and living quarters built over two decades with Iranian funding. Israeli Channel 14 reported that Israel received 'serious signs' Iran may resume war, while Prime Minister Netanyahu declared the mission to overthrow the Iranian regime is close. Concurrently, US strikes killed three Iranian Air Force pilots and four IRGC martyrs in Kermanshah, and US forces operate B-52 bombers from Royal Australian Air Force Base Tindall while claiming control of the Strait of Hormuz with nightly destruction of 30-40 Iranian vessels.

sections.title: Russian Advances Fuel Shortages Drone Production
sections.body: Russian forces advanced near Golubivka and Stupochky according to Ukrainian monitoring source DeepStateUA, while Russia's Ministry of Defense claimed liberation of Izhvka in the DPR. Russian strikes on Ukrainian warehouses and military bases have halved fuel supplies to Ukrainian forces, prompting complaints of fuel shortages among military personnel. Germany launched serial production of over 5,000 kamikaze drones for Ukraine at a cost of €300 million through a joint venture between Auterion and Airlogix. The SBU and GUR were involved in a shootout over Kaplunov's arrest, and Ukraine returned 13 citizens from occupation aged 27 to 87, including a Kherson couple held since February 2022.

sections.title: Hezbollah Infrastructure Cleared Iran Tensions Rise
sections.body: Israeli forces completed clearing Hezbollah's underground infrastructure on Mount Ali Taha ridge in southern Lebanon's security zone, discovering command centers, weapons rooms, and living quarters built over two decades with Iranian funding. Israeli Channel 14 reported Israel received 'serious signs' Iran may resume war, while Prime Minister Netanyahu declared the mission to overthrow the Iranian regime is close. US strikes killed three Iranian Air Force pilots and four IRGC martyrs in Kermanshah, and VP JD Vance warned the US only talks to Iran if they stop firing at ships, warning Gulf states that withdrawal would devastate global energy access. Trump claimed the US controls the Strait of Hormuz, destroying 30-40 Iranian boats nightly and targeting radars, while stating Iran's economy is collapsing with inflation potentially reaching 300%, and US B-52 bombers operate from Royal Australian Air Force Base Tindall.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Israeli destruction of Hezbollah's two-decade-old underground network, coupled with Netanyahu's claim that overthrowing Iran's regime is close, signals a heightened risk of Iranian retaliation while US strikes continue to inflict casualties on Iranian forces. Simultaneously, Russian advances and fuel supply cuts in Ukraine are being met with increased Western drone production, yet internal SBU-GUR tensions highlight potential coordination challenges that could affect Ukrainian defense effectiveness.
